title: Lily Radish (Lily F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Lily radish is an F1 hybrid radish variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Lily radish is an F1 hybrid radish variety, also sold or known as Lily F1. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Lily radish is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Lily F1, this is the same radish. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [radish variety finder](/crop-varieties/radish), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest about 45 days after sowing. Yield, by the seller's count: 10 to 15 t/ha (company figure). No trial on record checks these figures yet, so treat them as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit radish fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest about 45 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Root: white, smooth and cylindrical roots with no root hairs.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: a new radish hybrid in Allied Botanical's line. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual radish on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Lily radish

Labanos is fast. Pick a variety that stays crisp and does not turn pithy in the heat. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Fertilizer for vegetables](/blog/fertilizer-for-vegetables-philippines).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Lily F1 the same as Lily?
items.a: Yes. Lily F1 is another name for Lily. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Lily?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
